description: Shared-rule candidates found while authoring battle_system.logic.json — inlined there for now (same shape as a logic_rules entry).

candidates.name: Actions per round of a pc character
candidates.description: Catalog lookup of battle_system_core.turn_structure.actions_per_round_pc (3) so rules / effects / game modes do not hard-code the number.

candidates.name: Validation — the edge list holds (actor > defender) with bonus 1
candidates.description: True when some edge of the list has the given actor, defender and bonus_damage_to_actor 1. The 4-cycle validation calls it four times; creatures / game modes that override the matrix can reuse it.
candidates.note: Call with literal actor / defender codes (the iterating body only sees the current edge; a var-based code would need {"root": ...}).

candidates.name: Rounding contract check
candidates.description: Self-test of the half-up rounding every /10 in the paper uses: 5 → 1, 4 → 0, 0.5 → 1. Cheap regression for custom-op registration; could become a logic_rules example instead.
